text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَٰتٍۢ سِمَانٍۢ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌۭ وَسَبْعَ سُنۢبُلَٰتٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَٰتٍۢ ۖ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِى فِى رُءْيَٰىَ إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّءْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a new palace scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the narrative after the prison delay and moves the reader directly into the palace scene. The particle bridges the previous silence to royal speech, so the king's dream episode opens as a new but connected narrative beat.

topics.headline: resumptive palace transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not start from nowhere; it jumps from prison duration into palace speech as a connected new scene.
topics.reason: The conjunction rows and boundary rows all treat the opening as resumptive scene movement rather than simple addition.

words.gloss_range: completed Form I speech report introducing quoted discourse
words.root_gloss_range: speech and saying; here a completed reported royal utterance
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) makes the dream enter the story as a completed royal utterance. The ordinary speech root keeps the extraordinary vision inside a relay of reported speech, while later royal speech in the surah shows this utterance becoming a narrative lever (12:50; 12:54).

topics.headline: completed royal speech report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream is first handled as speech that can be transmitted and tested.
topics.reason: Grammar, form, and semantic rows converge on a plain completed Form I speech act.

topics.headline: royal speech as narrative relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king’s statement joins a chain of Surah 12 utterances whose wording moves events forward.
topics.reason: Intertext and structure rows connect the speech verb with dream reports, royal commands, and later court scenes.

words.gloss_range: definite singular royal subject, not a generic owner or abstract kingship
words.root_gloss_range: ownership, possession, rule, and sovereign control; here the definite Egyptian king
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَلِكُ}} ({{tr:al-maliku}}) identifies one known ruler as the speaker before the council is summoned. The {{ar:م ل ك}} ({{tr:m-l-k}}) root brings control and possession into the scene, but the local noun selects sovereign office; the title also distinguishes this ruler from Pharaoh-style naming while making royal speech the trigger for public consultation. The same royal title remains a narrative lever at later summons and court turns (12:50; 12:54).

topics.headline: known singular royal speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a single identifiable ruler initiates the public problem.
topics.reason: Definiteness, nominative subject evidence, and singular form fix the royal speaker.

topics.headline: control-root pressure narrowed to title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pressure of authority and control, while the local sense remains the king’s office.
topics.reason: Semantic rows preserve control and kingship pressure, but QAC grammar selects the definite noun title.

topics.headline: royal title anchors the dream relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream’s authority comes through the court’s central figure and is later answered by court action.
topics.reason: Same-surah and boundary rows tie the royal title to later royal commands and the addressed assembly.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person assertion introducing the king's dream report
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّي}} ({{tr:innī}}) places the king's first-person claim under emphatic assertion before the dream images arrive. The attached first-person marker is not decorative: it names the speaker as the bearer of the vision, while the assertion frame calibrates the court to hear the report as serious testimony. Recitationally, the first-person ending may be sounded or lightened, but the claim remains personal and asserted.

topics.headline: emphatic first-person report frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream report is presented as the king’s asserted testimony, not as detached narration.
topics.reason: Grammar and structure rows make the particle plus suffix the frame for the full seeing clause.

topics.headline: first-person vocal and reception pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the personal force of the king’s claim and its recitational handling.
topics.reason: Form and reception rows support the first-person assertion and qiraat treatment without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: present-vivid first-person seeing that governs the coordinated dream images
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, opining, and dream-vision; here first-person seeing in a dream report
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:arā}}) makes the dream vivid in the king's present voice. The verb governs the animal and grain images as one visual report, and its Form IV surface is narrowed to seeing rather than causing someone else to see. Through the {{ar:ر أ ي}} ({{tr:r-ʾ-y}}) root, this perception joins the Surah 12 dream chain that began with Joseph's seeing and passed through the prisoners' dreams (12:4; 12:36).

topics.headline: present vivid seeing, not causation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king speaks as if seeing the dream before the court, while grammar blocks a causative reading.
topics.reason: Form IV ambiguity is narrowed by local syntax and QAC grammar to first-person perception.

topics.headline: perception before interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that interpretation is demanded only after a staged act of seeing.
topics.reason: Semantic rows tie the verb to perception, opinion, and dream-vision without replacing the local seeing sense.

topics.headline: same-surah dream sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king’s dream report belongs to the same Surah 12 chain as Joseph and the prisoners.
topics.reason: Intertext and boundary rows connect this seeing verb with earlier dream reports and the prison-to-palace transition.

words.gloss_range: first seven as object-count for the fat cows
words.root_gloss_range: seven and sevenfold ordering; here the first accusative numeral in the dream count
words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}) begins the dream's counted order. Its accusative shape makes the first seven part of the seen object, and the repeated {{ar:س ب ع}} ({{tr:s-b-ʿ}}) pattern turns number into structure: fat cows, lean cows, and grain ears are measured against one another. The harvest-number resonance with multiplied grain remains secondary but audible (2:261), while the local force stays exact dream count.

topics.headline: first accusative seven as object count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream starts as a measured object before any interpretation is offered.
topics.reason: Grammar and numeral-form rows make the first seven the counted object of the seeing verb.

topics.headline: triple seven structures the dream
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dream’s architecture of repeated sevens rather than isolated images.
topics.reason: Semantic, structural, and echo rows show the local triadic numeral pattern.

topics.headline: seven linked to abundance fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seven can organize abundance and harvest associations, while the local force remains exact dream count.
topics.reason: Intertext rows with 2:261 are retained as number-and-harvest resonance, not as the local referent.

words.gloss_range: sound feminine plural cows bound to the preceding numeral
words.root_gloss_range: cattle and the root image of splitting or plowing; here counted individual cows
words.prose: {{ar:بَقَرَاتٍ}} ({{tr:baqarātin}}) turns the first count into individual cows rather than an undifferentiated cattle mass. The plural cow term carries agricultural and economic weight, while the local construct binds it tightly to the seven. Later retelling keeps this cattle phrase in the dream relay (12:46).

topics.headline: plural cows bound to the numeral
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices individual counted cattle, not vague livestock.
topics.reason: Construct and plural-form rows bind the noun to the numeral and individuate the animals.

topics.headline: cattle as agricultural resource sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the economic and agricultural charge of the cow image, while local grammar keeps the word as literal dream cattle.
topics.reason: Semantic rows preserve cattle as agrarian symbol without turning it into external dream theory.

topics.headline: cow image returns in relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this exact cattle image is stable enough to be repeated when the dream is carried onward (12:46).
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect this cow term with the later retelling and broader cow contrasts.

words.gloss_range: genitive plural adjective marking the cows as fat and resource-rich
words.root_gloss_range: fatness, richness, and stored bodily abundance; here the condition of the first cow group
words.prose: {{ar:سِمَانٍ}} ({{tr:simānin}}) makes abundance visible as body condition. The adjective is grammatically locked to the cows and semantically loaded with stored resource; its contrast with the lean group makes loss legible before any interpretation names famine. Its rare Surah 12 concentration keeps the word tied to the dream relay (12:46).

topics.headline: genitive fatness attached to cows
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abundance is carried by an adjective physically attached to the cow group.
topics.reason: Case and adjective-form rows link the word directly to the counted cows.

topics.headline: fatness as stored resource
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices abundance as embodied resource vulnerable to depletion.
topics.reason: Semantic rows connect fatness, food-richness, and the coming eating pressure.

topics.headline: rare dream-relay adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fat adjective belongs to a rare Surah 12 dream vocabulary and is answered by the lean adjective.
topics.reason: Rarity, echo, and contrast rows tie the form to 12:46 and to the local antithesis.

words.gloss_range: imperfect transitive consumption of the fat cows by the lean ones
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, and depletion; here an active dream verb with a feminine plural object suffix
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْكُلُهُنَّ}} ({{tr:yaʾkuluhunna}}) is the only finite action inside the dream picture. The imperfect makes consumption unfold, and the suffix sends the action back onto the fat cows. The ordinary {{ar:أ ك ل}} ({{tr:ʾ-k-l}}) field becomes abnormal predation: the lean consume the fat, turning nourishment-language into depletion and preparing Joseph's storage answer (12:47).

topics.headline: imperfect eating with feminine object suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly who is consumed: the suffix routes the action back to the fat cows.
topics.reason: Grammar, valency, and form rows show a transitive imperfect verb with a feminine plural patient.

topics.headline: lean devour fat as depletion image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eating is inverted into symbolic loss rather than ordinary nourishment.
topics.reason: Semantic rows preserve the abnormal dream predation and depletion force.

topics.headline: verb hinges object and subject groups
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this one verb joins the fat-cow object behind it to the lean-cow subject ahead of it.
topics.reason: Structure rows identify the eating verb as the syntactic hinge of the cow scene.

topics.headline: eating root moves toward storage interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root field moving from earlier loss claims to this symbolic dream and then to Joseph’s policy answer (12:17; 12:47).
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect the eating root with the wolf claim and the coming interpretation.

words.gloss_range: second seven as the devouring subject, parallel in number but reversed in role
words.root_gloss_range: seven and sevenfold ordering; here a nominative subject numeral
words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعٌ}} ({{tr:sabʿun}}) mirrors the first seven but changes grammatical role. Nominative case makes this seven the subject of the eating clause, so equal number becomes reversal: seven fat cows are consumed by seven lean ones.

topics.headline: nominative seven as devouring subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the matching number has shifted from object count to acting subject.
topics.reason: Case and ellipsis rows make the second seven the subject of the eating verb.

topics.headline: equal count with reversed role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices numerical symmetry working as narrative reversal.
topics.reason: Semantic and structural rows show the middle seven matching quantity while reversing agency.

words.gloss_range: nominative plural adjective specifying the lean cows
words.root_gloss_range: leanness, emaciation, and deprivation; here the visible condition of the devouring group
words.prose: {{ar:عِجَافٌ}} ({{tr:ʿijāfun}}) identifies the devouring subject by visible deprivation. The adjective agrees with the recovered cow group and answers the fat adjective with an image of famine-like leanness; its rarity and exact return in the relay keep the threat concentrated in Surah 12 (12:46).

topics.headline: nominative adjective recovers the lean cows
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ellipted cows are recovered through adjective agreement.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows link the adjective to the nominative numeral subject.

topics.headline: leanness opposes fatness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices famine pressure before it is interpreted: deprivation visibly devours abundance.
topics.reason: Semantic, contrast, and sound-texture rows all sharpen the lean image.

topics.headline: rare lean word in dream relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this leanness vocabulary is rare and returns with the dream’s retelling (12:46).
topics.reason: Rarity and echo rows tie the adjective to the Surah 12 dream cluster.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the plant-domain half of the dream
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the grain image without leaving the dream's measured structure. The conjunction divides the animal and plant domains, keeping both images active as coordinated parts of one vision.

topics.headline: conjunction adds the grain domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dream shifting from cattle to grain while remaining one coordinated report.
topics.reason: All rows describe coordination between the animal and plant halves of the dream.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct numeral opening the grain image
words.root_gloss_range: seven and sevenfold ordering; here the third numeral in the dream pattern
words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}) carries the seven-count into the grain half. Its accusative construct shape parallels the first cow count, and as the third local seven it completes the dream's numerical triad.

topics.headline: accusative construct grain count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grain image entering with the same counted-object grammar as the cow image.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows link the numeral to the following grain noun.

topics.headline: third seven completes repeated measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream is organized by repeated sevenfold units across both domains.
topics.reason: Semantic, structural, and echo rows preserve the triadic count.

words.gloss_range: specialized plural harvest term governed by the numeral
words.root_gloss_range: grain ears and harvest-bearing heads; here counted green ears in the dream
words.prose: {{ar:سُنْبُلَاتٍ}} ({{tr:sunbulātin}}) names the harvest-bearing ear rather than grain in general. Its specialized {{ar:س ن ب ل}} ({{tr:s-n-b-l}}) root and plural-form variants keep the image agricultural and technical; the term later moves from dream picture to storage instruction (12:47), with harvest multiplication also resonating at 2:261.

topics.headline: specialized counted harvest noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dream counts harvest-bearing ears, not generic plants.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows make the noun the genitive counted object and mark its plural shape.

topics.headline: rare harvest term concentrates grain image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grain image sharpened through a specialized and rare harvest lexeme.
topics.reason: Semantic and rarity rows support the specialized harvest value.

topics.headline: grain term links dream to policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same grain-ear vocabulary becomes the practical storage vocabulary in Joseph’s answer (12:47).
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect the word to 12:47 and the broader harvest field.

words.gloss_range: genitive plural quality marking the ears as green and productive
words.root_gloss_range: greenness, fresh growth, and living productivity; here the condition of the first grain group
words.prose: {{ar:خُضْرٍ}} ({{tr:khuḍrin}}) makes the first grain group visibly alive. Greenness is productive, not decorative: it marks fresh growth that the later storage instruction can turn into policy. Its opposition to dry ears gives the grain half its own abundance-scarcity contrast, while the wider growth field remains visible through rain-to-green imagery (6:99).

topics.headline: genitive greenness attached to ears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the green quality grammatically bound to the grain ears.
topics.reason: The grammar row attaches the adjective directly to the preceding grain noun.

topics.headline: greenness as productive vitality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life and yield in the grain before the dry counterpart appears.
topics.reason: Semantic and sound rows make greenness a sign of growth and productivity.

topics.headline: green root enters wider growth field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this local greenness participating in Quranic growth imagery while remaining the grain’s quality here.
topics.reason: Intertext rows compare rain-to-growth and green/dry patterns without changing the local adjective.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the dry counterpart within the grain image
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) creates the internal hinge within the grain scene. The first conjunction added a second domain; this one adds the contrasting condition inside that domain, so green and dry stand side by side.

topics.headline: second conjunction introduces dry counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grain scene has its own contrastive joint, not just another item in a list.
topics.reason: Grammar, structural, and echo rows all treat the particle as the hinge between green and dry grain groups.

words.gloss_range: feminine plural diptote adjective standing for the other ears
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, laterness, and being after; here a second grain group defined by its dryness
words.prose: {{ar:أُخَرَ}} ({{tr:ukhara}}) supplies a second grain group without repeating the grain noun or the seven. Its diptote form and delayed specification make otherness wait for its content: only the following dryness tells the reader what kind of others these are.

topics.headline: diptote other group in second slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a second grain group introduced by otherness rather than by repeated counting.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows explain the feminine plural diptote form and its slot after the green ears.

topics.headline: otherness specified by dryness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that otherness is not vague; it is defined by the dry quality that follows.
topics.reason: Semantic and structure rows show the adjective waiting for the following descriptor.

topics.headline: second group echoes the first grain phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase echo: another grain group is set against the green ears without repeating the full noun phrase.
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect the word to repeated interpretive and grain-group patterns.

words.gloss_range: plural active-participle adjective holding dryness as a stable condition
words.root_gloss_range: dryness, desiccation, and absence of moisture; here dry ears opposed to green ones
words.prose: {{ar:يَابِسَاتٍ}} ({{tr:yābisātin}}) closes the dream image on stable dryness. As a plural participial adjective, it holds desiccation as the condition of the other ears and answers greenness with absence of life-medium. The rare dry-grain signal returns in the dream retelling (12:46) and stands opposite the protected ears of Joseph's storage instruction (12:47).

topics.headline: participial dryness attached to other ears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dryness as a stable quality of the second grain group.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows identify the word as an adjectival active participle modifying the other ears.

topics.headline: dryness negates living productivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grain contrast as life-medium versus desiccation.
topics.reason: Semantic rows make dryness the negation of greenness and moisture.

topics.headline: rare dry signal in dream relay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dry-ear word is rare, returns in the retelling (12:46), and points toward the storage answer (12:47).
topics.reason: Intertext, echo, and rarity rows place the word in the Surah 12 dream and interpretation sequence.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle pivoting from dream report to direct appeal
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) pivots from reporting the vision to addressing the court. The open vocative turns the dream from private royal perception into a public request for interpretation.

topics.headline: direct address after dream report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from narrated vision to court appeal at this particle.
topics.reason: Vocative, discourse, and sound rows all identify the particle as the hinge into direct address.

words.gloss_range: formal vocative connector requiring a definite nominative addressee
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) formalizes the address and requires the definite council noun that follows. The stacked vocative frame elevates the request into official court speech rather than casual questioning.

topics.headline: formal address frame for the council
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the courtly register created before the council is named.
topics.reason: Grammar and formula rows show the particle requiring a definite nominative addressee and opening a formal request.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative council addressed as the formal interpretive body
words.root_gloss_range: filling, fullness, and elite assembly; here the definite royal council
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَلَأُ}} ({{tr:al-malaʾu}}) names the formal audience as the full council. The {{ar:م ل أ}} ({{tr:m-l-ʾ}}) root gives the assembly fullness and elite weight, while the collective singular contrasts with the singular king. The consultation formula also resonates with royal council speech elsewhere (27:32), and it matters here because this filled court soon fails the interpretive task (12:44).

topics.headline: definite nominative council target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king addresses the council as a defined official body.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows make the noun the appositional specification of the vocative.

topics.headline: assembly fullness and elite pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why a ruling is expected from this body: it is the filled court elite.
topics.reason: Semantic rows preserve the root image of fullness and elite assembly.

topics.headline: royal consultation body before failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the council term belongs to a royal consultation formula that is immediately tested.
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows connect the address to elite-council scenes and 12:44 failure.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative asking the council to give the king a ruling
words.root_gloss_range: formal ruling, authoritative answer, and the youth/ruling root family; here a plural imperative for an interpretive ruling
words.prose: {{ar:أَفْتُونِي}} ({{tr:aftūnī}}) turns the dream into a request for authoritative judgment. The form corrects to the {{ar:ف ت و}} ({{tr:f-t-w}}) root, not the erroneous assignment noted in the bundle, and the plural imperative plus first-person object compresses command and beneficiary. Its Surah 12 path is sharp: the court is asked here, but the request is redirected to Joseph in 12:46.

topics.headline: plural imperative for authoritative interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king requests a formal ruling, not a casual explanation.
topics.reason: Grammar, semantic, and form rows support the formal fatwa-giving sense while narrowing away an ordinary tell-me reading.

topics.headline: bundle root anomaly corrected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local word belongs to the ruling-giving root despite the noted root-assignment anomaly.
topics.reason: The MASAQ-error row is preserved as correction: QAC alignment and the bundle itself identify the correct root.

topics.headline: court request shifts toward Joseph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the request moving from royal council to Joseph when the council cannot answer (12:46).
topics.reason: Intertext, structure, and boundary rows link the imperative to the royal consultation formula, competence test, and later handoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the topic or domain of the requested ruling
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) marks the dream as the topic in which the ruling is sought. It is broader than a flat about-marker: it places the council inside the domain of the vision request, while the later lām phrase marks the field of interpretive skill.

topics.headline: preposition governs the ruling topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested fatwa is routed into the king’s vision as its domain.
topics.reason: Grammar and structure rows show the preposition governing the topic of the request.

topics.headline: inside-language becomes concern domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a deeper domain sense while the local function remains concerning the vision.
topics.reason: Semantic rows preserve the inside/concern overlap without making the preposition spatial only.

words.gloss_range: possessed dream-vision noun objectified as the topic for ruling
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, vision, and meaningful dream; here the king's possessed vision
words.prose: {{ar:رُؤْيَايَ}} ({{tr:ruʾyāya}}) makes the vision personally definite: it is the king's dream, owned by the speaker who just said he sees. The noun selects meaningful vision rather than ordinary sleeping confusion, and its later definite echo frames the request as both this case and the tested craft.

topics.headline: possessed dream noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is first the king’s own vision, not yet the general craft of interpretation.
topics.reason: Grammar and form rows make the suffix possessive and objectify the seen dream as the request topic.

topics.headline: vision as significant dream
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king classifies the image as meaningful enough to require judgment.
topics.reason: Semantic rows distinguish meaningful vision language from ordinary dream confusion.

topics.headline: owned vision echoed by definite vision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local ring from the king’s vision to the definite vision-domain at the condition.
topics.reason: Intertext, echo, qiraat, and boundary rows connect the word to the Surah 12 dream vocabulary and the later repeat.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle placing the council's competence under test
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) turns the command into a competence test. The king has already ordered an interpretation, but the condition leaves the council's ability open and compresses the answer: if you truly interpret visions, then answer.

topics.headline: condition scopes council ability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the king’s request carries doubt or challenge about whether the council can actually do this.
topics.reason: Grammar and semantic rows make the particle govern a competence condition.

topics.headline: condition qualifies the imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pressure tail after the command, anticipating the council’s failure in 12:44.
topics.reason: Structure and boundary rows show the condition borrowing its answer from the prior imperative and looking ahead to inability.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural perfect functioning as a present-state competence condition
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and existing as a state; here established interpretive capacity in a condition
words.prose: {{ar:كُنْتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) does not ask whether the council once existed; it predicates an established state of competence. The second-person plural tests the whole assembly: are you, as a body, people for whom dream-crossing is a real capacity? The conditional being formula also joins other Surah 12 tests of action, capacity, and outcome (12:10; 12:85; 12:111).

topics.headline: perfect form as present competence state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices established ability being tested, not a one-time attempt.
topics.reason: Grammar and semantic rows explain the perfect form in the conditional idiom as present-state capacity.

topics.headline: plural capacity assigned to the whole council
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entire court assembly is being measured as capable or incapable.
topics.reason: Challenge and second-plural rows make the capacity collective.

topics.headline: conditional being formula in Surah 12
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this condition joining other Surah 12 tests of action and capacity.
topics.reason: Intertext and echo rows compare the formula with 12:10, 12:85, and the surah’s lesson frame.

words.gloss_range: preposition of application or domain attached to the vision noun
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) fuses with the definite vision noun to mark the field of application before the verb arrives. The fronted lām phrase foregrounds visions as the specific domain in which the council's skill is being tested.

topics.headline: lām marks the vision domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visions are the applied field of interpretation, not the possessor of the action.
topics.reason: Grammar and semantic rows treat the preposition as application or concern.

topics.headline: bound fronted domain before verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact fronting of the vision-domain before the interpretation verb.
topics.reason: Form and structure rows show the bound preposition and fronted prepositional phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْبُرُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿburūna}}) closes the ayah on the demanded skill. The {{ar:ع ب ر}} ({{tr:ʿ-b-r}}) root keeps interpretation as crossing from image to meaning, and Form I preserves traversal more than mere verbal expression. The second-person imperfect asks whether this is the council's habitual capacity; its marked rarity, immediate failure in 12:44, and later lesson echo at 12:111 make the final word both the court's problem and the surah's broader reading model.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fat/lean cattle and green/dry ears are joined by eating and opposed material states.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two domains present the same asymmetry: embodied abundance and living crop matter stand opposite emaciation and desiccation, while eating converts the stronger stock into support for the weaker consumer.

activation_trace.role: Literal cattle supply one embodied register for the resource contrast.
Earth-cutting and furrowing connect the cattle register to cultivated land.
Fatness contributes accumulated bodily reserve as the resource-rich pole.
Consumption of wealth turns eating into depletion rather than mere feeding.
Emaciation supplies the deficit state that paradoxically consumes reserve.
Verdant flourishing supplies the crop-domain analogue of bodily abundance.
Loss of moisture supplies the crop-domain deficit corresponding to leanness.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports two disconnected marvels, one zoological and one botanical.
changed_reading.after: The two marvels form one resource-depletion model rendered across body and crop.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seven recurs three times, while another set of ears and the request to cross the dream align the image groups.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated cardinality makes the cattle sets and ear sets mutually indexable; otherness or lateness separates states, and interpretation is the crossing that seeks a sequence behind the visible correspondence.

activation_trace.role: The repeated number supplies equal-sized units that align otherwise different images.
Otherness after a first set separates the ears into correlated classes.
Delay to a later time activates a possible sequence within the paired classes.
Passage from one side to another supplies the structural move between image sets.
Dream transfer from surface to meaning makes the correspondences interpretive evidence.

changed_reading.before: Seven is only a repeated decorative number inside an uncanny scene.
changed_reading.after: Seven makes the contrasting sets commensurable and invites a phased reading, though the focus alone does not identify the units as years.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A king addresses the assembled elite, requests a formal answer, and conditions it on their ability to interpret.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dream moves from private seeing into a public decision channel: sovereign concern is placed before a deliberative body, which is asked to turn ambiguous images into a judgment capable of sustaining rule.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty makes the vision a matter with public rather than merely private scope.
The mainstay of an affair frames the requested meaning as support for governance.
An elite body gathered for opinion supplies the deliberative institution.
Clarifying a difficult judgment turns interpretation into an answer with decision force.
Reflection and consultation connect repeated seeing to collective deliberation.
Making one condition a lesson for another gives the answer prospective practical force.

changed_reading.before: The king asks courtiers to solve a private symbolic puzzle.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an institutional attempt to convert uncertain perception into public judgment and preparedness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier prison dreams establish interpretation as tracing an image to its eventual outcome, and their resolution is presented as a decisive matter; this sharpens the focus request from resemblance-finding into forecast.

activation_trace.role: Moving a dream from appearance to meaning supplies the focus operation being sharpened.
Return to an eventual outcome makes interpretation track what an image will become.
A cutting, decisive judgment makes the interpreted outcome operationally settled.

structural_cues: 12:36 supplies two concrete dream operations, while 12:41 states their differentiated outcomes and closes them as decided.
Eating already links dream image and realized loss before the royal vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior image-to-outcome cases and a decisive closure; I infer that the same hermeneutic function governs 12:43. A live alternative is that the prison examples establish credibility without fixing the royal dream's temporal form.

changed_reading.before: Interpreting the royal dream could be a free symbolic gloss.
changed_reading.after: Interpreting it means recovering a prospective event structure fit for action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assembled elite classify the dream as a mixed bundle and explicitly disclaim knowledge, so the focus address exposes an institutional bottleneck rather than identifying the actual interpretive authority.

activation_trace.role: The opinion-gathering elite supply the institutional gate tested by the request.
The demand for a clarifying answer defines the competence the council fails to provide.
A mixed handful supplies the council's diagnosis of incoherent aggregation.
Dream occurrence supplies the class they dismiss rather than successfully interpret.
Knowledge as disclosure, under explicit negation, marks the unavailable court capacity.

structural_cues: The council's plural reply answers the royal plural address but substitutes classification and disclaimer for interpretation.
The negative construction in 12:44 makes non-knowledge institutional and explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the request, the mixed-bundle label, and the knowledge disclaimer; I infer that rank and assembly do not guarantee interpretive access. Alternatively, the council may be appropriately refusing an evidentially noisy dream rather than simply failing.

changed_reading.before: The council is the natural expert body expected to convert the vision into policy.
changed_reading.after: The address tests and reveals the court's interpretive limit, forcing meaning to travel outside the expected institution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgetting leaves the capable interpreter inaccessible through years of confinement; later recollection launches a messenger to a truth-marked outsider whose answer can return to the public. Meaning is activated by a delayed social relay, not produced inside the council.

activation_trace.role: Meaning carried through speech supplies the focus anchor for a relay reading.
Neglect interrupts access to the interpreter and stores capacity outside court awareness.
Remaining in place gives the interrupted access a durable temporal cost.
Recollection after forgetting reactivates the dormant route to meaning.
Message-bearing turns interpretation into a mediated trip beyond the council.
Established soundness relocates interpretive authority in the absent outsider.
Returning speech completes the circuit from court to interpreter and back to people.

structural_cues: 12:45 shifts from remembered capacity to the imperative to send, and 12:46 states an intended return to the people.
The focus dream is repeated nearly verbatim at the remote interpretive site.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, prolonged confinement, recollection, sending, truthful status, and return; I infer a distributed knowledge circuit. The alternative is a narrower plot-device reading in which these details only explain how Joseph is contacted.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks whether the people present can interpret.
changed_reading.after: The focus initiates a delayed relay in which absent, socially buried competence must be remembered, reached, and returned to the public.

context_deltas.mechanism: Continuous cultivation is followed by harvesting, leaving produce in its ears, restricting consumption, and fortifying a remainder. The green ear changes from a prosperity sign into the material envelope of a preservation protocol.

activation_trace.role: The grain ear supplies the focus object reclassified as protective storage.
Tender living crop matter supplies what must be preserved through the abundant phase.
Cultivation and growth establish the production side of the storage cycle.
Persistent effort makes abundance a sustained program rather than passive fortune.
Cutting the crop marks the transition from production to preservation.
Leaving the harvest untouched assigns the ear a protective retention function.
Smallness constrains current consumption so the larger stock remains.
Preservation inside a surrounding fort confirms the reserve's protected status.

structural_cues: The command in 12:47 places the harvested crop inside its own ears except for the portion eaten.
The exception clauses in 12:47-48 distinguish controlled use from protected reserve.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, harvest, leaving-in-ear, rationing, and fortification; I infer that the ear functions as storage technology. A live alternative is that leaving grain unthreshed is only a handling instruction, though the later fortified remainder supports preservation.

changed_reading.before: Green ears merely symbolize a flourishing crop.
changed_reading.after: Green ears encode both productive abundance and the physical method by which abundance survives into scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later block of seven hard units consumes what was advanced for it, except a protected remainder. This identifies the lean eaters as personified scarcity-years and the fat bodies as previously accumulated reserves.

activation_trace.role: Equal groups of seven provide the count mapped onto successive periods.
Consumption of wealth supplies the exact action performed by scarcity on reserves.
Emaciation marks the consuming period as a deficit condition.
After-before ordering fixes the two sevenfold groups as successive phases.
Severe hardness supplies the operative quality of the consuming years.
A previously advanced stock identifies what the later years consume.
The enclosed remainder prevents the consumption model from becoming total annihilation.

structural_cues: 12:48 preserves the focus grammar by making seven hard units the grammatical eaters.
The phrase describing what was advanced for them supplies a backward dependency between the two phases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seven hard units eating prior provision; I identify those units with the lean seven and the provision with fat abundance. The cattle could retain an independent livestock reference, but the repeated eating grammar strongly favors a unified reserve model.

changed_reading.before: Lean cattle impossibly overpower and eat fat cattle.
changed_reading.after: Hard future years consume the material surplus accumulated during earlier productive years, with deliberate reserves surviving the drawdown.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the two sevenfold phases comes a singular year of rain or rescue and productive pressing. Because this restorative phase has no obvious separate image in the focus, interpretation proves capable of extrapolating beyond one-to-one symbol substitution.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time keeps the focus sequence open beyond its first contrast.
Desiccation supplies the terminal focus state from which restoration departs.
Explicit after-before ordering appends a phase beyond the hard seven.
A single annual cycle distinguishes restoration from both sevenfold blocks.
Life-giving rain supplies the material reversal of dryness.
Succor under distress preserves a social rescue reading alongside rainfall.
Pressing until yield resumes productive extraction after survival.

structural_cues: The singular year follows two explicitly sevenfold periods.
No separate ninth image class in 12:43 transparently corresponds to this restorative year.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later singular year, rescue or rain, and pressing; I infer a third restoration phase and a non-bijective interpretation. The split غ ي ث targets leave both meteorological rain and broader relief materially live.

changed_reading.before: The vision is exhausted by a closed binary of seven abundant and seven depleted units.
changed_reading.after: The binary is a crisis interval inside a larger trajectory that includes an unpictured restorative year.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful interpreter does not accept immediate royal access; he requires inquiry until truth emerges and his truthful status is publicly confirmed. Reliable interpretation is paired with an audit of the interpreter, not merely with sovereign demand.

activation_trace.role: Royal authority supplies the access offer that the interpreter delays.
Clarifying a difficult answer anchors competence while context tests credibility.
Inquiry redirects the royal summons toward unresolved evidence.
Truth becoming exposed supplies the audit's public resolution.
Stable correspondence with reality defines the evidentiary standard reached.
Truthful speech publicly confirms the interpreter's credibility.

structural_cues: The interpreter sends the royal messenger back before appearing at court.
The investigation culminates in first-person confession rather than a bare assertion of innocence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deferred access, inquiry, confession, and truth language; I infer that public credibility is a prerequisite for durable policy authority. Alternatively, the inquiry may serve personal exoneration without being a general condition of interpretation.

changed_reading.before: Correct interpretation alone is enough to satisfy the king's request.
changed_reading.after: Interpretive competence becomes publicly usable only after the interpreter and the court record pass a truth-revealing inquiry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The king singles out and empowers the interpreter, who is then placed over the land's storehouses as a vigilant guardian. The focus request therefore culminates not in explanatory speech alone but in assignment of the diagnosed resources to competent custody.

activation_trace.role: The affair's mainstay anchors the move from royal concern to a sustaining office.
A clarifying judgment supplies the competence later converted into office.
Exclusive selection transfers the interpreter from remote adviser to royal appointee.
Empowered capacity gives the interpreted policy an executable agent.
Appointment into a new condition supplies the institutional conversion.
Securing stored goods makes resource preservation the office's concrete object.
Vigilant wakefulness defines the human capacity needed to guard the reserve.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from royal speech and conversation in 12:54 directly to an appointment request over storehouses in 12:55.
The interpreter's paired self-description joins custodial reliability to knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, empowerment, appointment, storehouses, and vigilant guardianship; I infer that the dream also functions as a recruitment event for crisis administration. An alternative is that appointment follows broader demonstrated character, with interpretation only opening access.

changed_reading.before: The requested fatwa ends when the dream receives a correct explanation.
changed_reading.after: The answer reorganizes authority: the interpreter becomes steward of the very reserves whose management the images disclose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant ر ء ي to ر و ي mapping and crosses dream language into hydrology. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root, green/dry matter, royal control, and the later rain event. Downstream prose should present it as a latent branch activation, not as a claim that the ordinary word for vision etymologically means irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated vision language sits beside verdure, desiccation, agrarian animals, and a king whose branch inventory includes water as control of affairs.

activation_trace.role: Quenching versus thirst makes repeated vision tokens latent carriers of water sufficiency.
Bringing and carrying water supplies a possible causal channel for crop and cattle states.
Water as what lets a group control its affair joins hydrology to royal preparedness.
Tender green growth supplies the water-positive material state.
Moisture loss supplies the water-negative material state.
Riverbank vegetation links interpretive crossing to the boundary where water sustains growth.
Descending life-giving rain makes water an explicit driver of the restored phase.

changed_reading.before: Water is only an unstated environmental background to green and dry crops.
changed_reading.after: A contained split-root reading treats water availability as the hidden control variable joining vision, royal capacity, crop condition, and restoration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the visible form is plainly the numeral, yet its same-root beast and excessive-taking branches animate the impossible eaters. It remains anchored in three focus occurrences of seven, explicit eating, and the later hard seven that eat provision. Downstream prose should call this personifying branch resonance, not replace the cardinal meaning with 'beasts.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The second seven is the grammatical eater, so the repeated numeral can resonate with predation while retaining its count.

activation_trace.role: The predatory beast image turns a numbered deficit period into an attacking consumer.
Excessive taking and harm intensify the consuming seven beyond neutral enumeration.
Prey prepared for eating supplies the fat group's role inside the predatory scene.
The force of attack and rushing gives the hard years pack-like agency.
Provision placed in advance becomes what the personified pack overtakes.

changed_reading.before: Seven only measures the duration or size of each set.
changed_reading.after: The consuming seven also behaves as a predatory pack, giving scarcity active violence while preserving the literal count.

strongest_changes: The paired animal and crop images become a fourteen-year reserve cycle in which hard years consume accumulated surplus.
Green ears become preservation technology, not merely signs of abundance.
The failed court consultation becomes a delayed relay to an outsider and ultimately an appointment over storehouses.
A singular relief year opens the apparently closed two-phase vision into a larger trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses ecology, temporal accounting, institutional failure, knowledge transfer, and administrative succession into one impossible act of lean bodies eating fat ones. The split-root inventories also keep hydrological and predatory resonances alive without requiring them to displace the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone supports paired phases but does not independently establish that each seven is a year.
The relief year may be activated by rain, broader rescue, or both.
The hydrological and predatory readings are branch-backed resonances, not secure lexical disambiguations.
The interpreter's appointment may arise from the dream solution specifically or from the larger public demonstration of truth and competence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The dream reverses ordinary material flow.** ر ء ي B003, س ب ع B001, ب ق ر B001, س م ن B001, ء ك ل B001, ع ج ف B001, س ن ب ل B001, خ ض ر B002, and ي ب س B001 present fullness consumed by wasting and fresh growth paired with dryness. I infer a transfer from stored vitality to depletion. The ayah reads as an ecological-economic process compressed into impossible images.
2. **The council is asked to cross from surface to mechanism.** م ل ء B002 (assembled elite), ف ت ي B004, and ع ب ر B002 (carrying a dream from surface to meaning) make interpretation a public governance task. The requested crossing is from image to actionable temporal relation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:47-49 converted the impossible images into a precise production, storage, depletion, and relief schedule.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Interpretation as crossing from image into policy-bearing meaning.** `ع ب ر:B002` is explicitly “carrying a dream from its surface to its meaning,” grounded in `ع ب ر:B001`, passing from one side to another. The dream’s paired visual states are dismissed in 12:44, carried to Joseph in 12:45-46, and converted into a fourteen-year agricultural sequence in 12:47-48. The packet supplies the two sides; I infer that the requested crossing must preserve relations among the images so they can organize action. *Taʿburūn* reads as structured transport, not free symbolic association.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:47-49 converts the dream crossing into a timed agricultural protocol, confirming that interpretation is validated by its capacity to organize action across the predicted sequence.

baseline.text: Kral dedi ki: "Ben yedi zayıf ineğin yedi semiz ineği yediğini, ayrıca yedi yeşil başak ile diğer kuru başakları görüyorum. Ey ileri gelenler! Rüya yorumlayabiliyorsanız rüyam hakkında bana görüş bildirin."

findings.text: Rüya, doluluğun zayıflık tarafından tüketilmesini ve taze büyümenin kuruluğa dönüşmesini göstererek yaşam gücünün tükenişe aktarılmasını tek görüntüde sıkıştırır.
Rüyayı yorumlama talebi, görüntülerin yüzeyinden yönetimi yönlendirecek zamansal işleyişe geçme görevini ileri gelenlere yükler.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (12:36-57): Dream images cross into outcomes
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Image-bearing scenes are transferred from dream surface to executable interpretation and then to materially different fates.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interpretation is a crossing operation: it carries food, bodies, service, and death from one representational side to another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Interpretation transfers surface to terminus
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A requested answer crosses from dream form to its return, report, and decisive result.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: return to final outcome `quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`; transferring a dream from surface to meaning `quranic:root_000974:B002/m01`; clarifying judgment in an answer `quranic:root_001130:B004/m01`; delivered report `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`; decisive judgment `quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interpreter carries an image to the place where it returns as event. Answering, reporting, and judging are coordinated acts that prevent interpretation from remaining an associative gloss.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (12:36-57): Agrarian time becomes storage architecture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Temporal knowledge is made actionable by converting abundance into protected form before scarcity can consume it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Pressing links rain and extracted yield, while the same root supplies the latent image of grain protected inside its husk.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Herd and crop images stage consumption
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Counted fat cattle and green ears are paired with lean cattle, dry ears, and eating.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sevenfold count `quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`; cattle `quranic:root_000139:B001/m01`; fatness `quranic:root_000744:B001/m01`; emaciation `quranic:root_000986:B001/m01`; grain ear `quranic:root_000746:B001/m01`; fresh green plant `quranic:root_000418:B002/m01`; dried plant `quranic:root_001691:B003/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The dream makes time visible as bodies and crops. Abundance and scarcity do not simply alternate; the latter is pictured actively eating the former, which prepares the need for defensive storage.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.
يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.branch_image_ar: قول ما لم يكن أو نسبته
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hükümdarı halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyan yönetici olarak tanımlar; hükümranlık, ülke, halk üzerindeki siyaset ve özellikle ilahi mutlak egemenlik bu kamusal yönetim çekirdeğinde birleşir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hükümdar ve hükümranlık çekirdeği korunur; ülke, mutlak ilahi egemenlik ve birini hükümdar yapma kullanımları kendi biçim ve kalıplarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın halk üzerinde emir, yasak ve yönetim yetkisi kullanmasıyla kurulan kamusal hükümranlıktır. Bu alan hükümdarı, yönetim gücünü, hükmedilen ülkeyi ve ilahi bağlamda mutlak egemenliği kapsar.

facets.statement: Hükümdar, halk üzerinde emir ve yasak koyarak kamusal yönetim yetkisi kullanır.
Hükümranlık, yöneticinin halkı ve ülkesindeki etkili yönetim alanını kapsar.
İlahi bağlamda bütün varlık üzerindeki mutlak ve kalıcı egemenlik anlatılır.
Bir topluluk bir kişiyi başına geçirerek onu hükümdar konumuna getirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu alanı halk üzerinde emir ve yasakla işleyen yönetim gücü etrafında toplar; hükümdar, hükümranlık, ülke ve ilahi mutlak egemenlik aynı kamusal yetki ekseninin farklı görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetici kişiyi, halk üzerindeki hüküm gücünü ve bu gücün ülkesini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hükümdar, yönetim, halk, ülke ve egemenlik ilişkisini birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Soyut hükümranlığı, ülkeyi ve ilahi mutlak egemenliği dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Halk ve ülke üzerindeki yönetim gücü soyut olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir işin ayakta kalmasını ve düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temel dayanağı açıkça tanımlar; kalbin beden için örnek verilmesi bu genel bağımlılık ilişkisinin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız dayanak bildiren belirtili kalıplarda geçerlidir; kökün çıplak biçimine genel bir temel veya öz anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düzenin veya bedenin ayakta kalmasını, düzgün işlemesini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan temel dayanak unsurudur. Kalbin beden için bu işlevi görmesi verilen başlıca örnektir.

facets.statement: Bir unsur, daha büyük bir işin veya düzenin dayandığı ve onun düzgün işlemesini sağlayan temeldir.
Bu dayanak, işin doğruluğunu, sürekliliğini ve tamamlanmasını sağlayan belirleyici koşul olur.
Kalp, bedenin işleyişinin kendisine dayandığı temel unsur olarak gösterilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, bir işin kendisine dayandığı ve onun düzgün kalmasını sağlayan temel unsurdur; kalbin bedenle ilişkisi bu bağımlılık yapısını somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir düzenin varlığını ve düzgün işlemesini kendisine borçlu olduğu unsur için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dayanılan unsur, ayakta kalma ve düzgün işleme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

error_profile.adds: Beden parçası üzerinden güçlü bir mecaz ve örgütsel önem çağrışımı ekler.

concept_map.definition: Su, yolcunun veya bir topluluğun işini denetim altında tutmasını, konaklamasını ve geçimini sürdürmesini sağlayan temel kaynaktır. Suyun bulunmaması bu yeterliğin yokluğu, çok sayıda su kaynağı ise güçlü yaşam imkânı olarak anlatılır.

facets.statement: Su, yolcunun veya topluluğun işlerini yürütebilmesini sağlayan temel kaynaktır.
Su kaynakları konaklama, geçim ve topluluk düzeninin sürmesini mümkün kılar.
Suyun yokluğu çaresizlik, çok sayıda su kaynağı ise geniş yaşam imkânı olarak ifade edilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: رويت على أهلي أروي ريا (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ رويت القوم أرويهم إذا استقيت لهم (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الراوية البعير أو البغل أو الحمار الذي يستقى عليه (sihah)؛ الراوية هو البعير الذي يستقى عليه الماء والرجل المستقي أيضا راوية (tahdhib)؛ يوم التروية سمي به لأنهم يرتوون فيه من الماء (sihah;tahdhib)

root_profile.summary: Kök, suya kanma ve su taşıma çevresinden söz aktarma, düşünerek değerlendirme, ihtiyaç, kalan miktar, yük bağı, yapı bağımlı dolgunluk, görünüş, koku, hayvan, bayrak, uyak harfi, yağmur bulutu ve toplumsal yük taşıyan önderlere uzanan çok sayıda bağımsız dal içerir. Dalların bir bölümü su, taşıma ve doluluk benzetileriyle tarihsel olarak ilişkilendirilebilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında ayrı sınırlar gerektirir.

concept_gloss.text: suya kanma ve içeni kandıran su

contextual_glosses.text: içene yeten tatlı ve bol su

lu_005.text: içeni kandıran tatlı ve bol su

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yedi sayısını çekirdek alır; yedide bir payı, bir topluluğun yedincisi olmayı, yetmişi, yedi günlük ya da yedi aşamalı dönemleri ve yedi kez yapılan işlemleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Bazı kullanımlarda yedi, kesin sayımın ötesinde çoğaltma ve pekiştirme de bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın sayı ve kesir anlamlarını korurken hafta, yedi tur, yedi gece ve yedi kez yapma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Yedi sayısını ve bu sayıya göre kurulan pay, sıra, dönem, çevrim ya da yineleme ilişkilerini anlatır. Bazı bağlı kullanımlarda tam yediyle sınırlı kalmadan çoğaltma ve pekiştirme işlevi kazanır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, altıdan sonra ve sekizden önce gelen yedi sayısı ile bir grubun yedincisi olma durumudur.
Bir bütünün yedi eşit parçasından biri ile altmıştan sonra gelen yetmişlik onluk da sayı çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
Yedi günlük hafta ve yedi aşamalı çevrimler, sayının zaman ya da hareket düzenine uygulanmasıdır.
Develerin belirli bir yedi temelli aralıkla suya götürülmesi, sayıya bağlı özel bir sulama düzenidir.
Yedi tur atma, yedi gecede okuma, yedi gece kalma, yedinci günde işlem yapma ve yedi kez yıkama yalnız kendi kalıplarında geçerlidir.
Yediyle türetilen kimi ifadeler, kesin bir sayım yerine kat kat artırma ya da çokluk bildirebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yedi sayısıdır; kesir, sıra, hafta, yetmiş, yedi aşamalı uygulamalar ve özel sulama düzeni bu sayıdan türetilir. Toplu kanıt ayrıca yedinin bazı bağlamlarda kesin sınır değil, çoğaltma ve pekiştirme aracı olabildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yedi sayısı ve yediye dayalı pay, sıra, dönem, işlem ve çokluk anlatımları
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın sayı çekirdeğini, doğrudan türevlerini ve yalnız belirli yapılarda ortaya çıkan yedi temelli uygulamaları birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yedi sayısını, sayısal ilişkileri, dönemleri, işlemleri ve pekiştirme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğrudan sayı bildiren ve bir kişiyi grubun yedincisi yapan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel sayı değerini ve yedinci olma ilişkisinin sayısal tabanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kesir, dönem, özel işlem ve sayıyı aşan pekiştirme kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bütünün yedi eşit parçasından birini ya da malın bu orandaki payını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yedi eşit parçadan birini eksiksiz biçimde belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hafta ya da yedi güne göre düzenlenen zaman çevrimi söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yedi güne dayalı dönem ve çevrim sınırını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yedi sayısının kesin sayım değil, çoğaltma ve pekiştirme görevi gördüğü bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesin yedi sınırını aşabilen çoğaltma ve pekiştirme işlevini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Aynı kökün başka bir dalındaki yüzey benzerliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sayı, kesir, sıra, dönem ve yineleme ilişkilerinin tümünü yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Canlı ve avlanma anlamını yanlış biçimde ekler.

error_profile.preserves: Yalnız aynı kökten gelen başka bir kullanımın biçimsel izini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yediye bağlı bütün sayısal ve dönemsel içeriği yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Sözle zarar verme anlamını yanlış biçimde ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tam olarak yediyi ve yediye dayalı kesir, sıra, dönem ve işlemleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ondan küçük belirsiz bir sayı aralığını anlatır ve sınırı kaynaklara göre değişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kesin yedi ile belirsiz küçük sayı aralığı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ondan küçük sayıların nicelik alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın değeri sabit olarak yedidir; komşu ise tek bir sayıya değil, çoğunlukla üç ile dokuz arasında değişen belirsiz bir aralığa gönderir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir bütünün yedi eşit parçasından birini ve yediyle ilgili daha geniş türevleri içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız bir bütünün dokuz eşit parçasından birini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün eşit parçalara bölünmesinden doğan kesirleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Payda odak dalda yedi, komşu dalda dokuzdur; ayrıca odak dal kesrin ötesinde sayı, sıra ve dönem kullanımlarına da uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün komşular değerlendirildi; yalnız kesin sayı sınırını ve kesir ayrımını en açık gösteren iki karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السبعة والسبع جزء من سبعة، وكون المرء سابع القوم أو أخذ سبع المال، وجعل الشيء سبعة، والسبعون، والأسبوع وسبعة الأشواط أو الليالي، وظمء الإبل، والتسبيع بمعنى التضعيف أو التكثير.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السين والباء والعين أصلان أحدهما في العدد؛ السبعة؛ السبع جزء من سبعة؛ سبعت القوم إذا أخذت سبع أموالهم أو كنت لهم سابعا؛ السبع ظمء من أظماء الإبل (maqayis)؛ السبع من العدد معروف؛ صرت سابعهم؛ سبع الشيء واحد من سبعة؛ الأسبوع؛ طفت بالبيت سبعا وسبوعا؛ سبع المولود؛ سبعت الإناء؛ سبع الله لك أي أعطاك أجرك سبع مرات (jamhara)؛ سبعة رجال وسبع نسوة؛ السبع جزء من سبعة؛ السبع الظمء؛ الأسبوع من الأيام؛ تسبيعا جعلته سبعة؛ وزن سبعة (sihah)؛ السبع من العدد معروف؛ السبعون معروف؛ أقام عندها سبعا؛ سبع فلان القرآن؛ الأسبوع؛ التكثير والتضعيف لا من باب حصر العدد (tahdhib)؛ أصل السبع العدد؛ سبع سماوات؛ سبعين مرة؛ سبعا من المثاني؛ السبع الطوال؛ السبيع والسبع في الورود؛ الأسبوع؛ طفت بالبيت أسبوعا؛ سبعت القوم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlara ya da hayvanlara saldırıp onları avlayan dişli yırtıcıları çekirdek alır ve dişi hayvanı, bu hayvanların bol olduğu yeri, sürüye saldırmayı ve av sonucunu buna bağlar. Ancak sınıfın sınırı her etçil hayvanı kapsamaz; bazı hayvanların dışarıda bırakılması açıkça belirtilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yırtıcı hayvan anlamı çekirdektir; yer, yem etme, sürüye saldırma, yavrusunu yitirme ve çobanın uğradığı olay yalnız ilgili yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlara ya da başka hayvanlara saldıran, onları yakalayıp yiyen dişli yırtıcı hayvanı anlatır. Bu çekirdekten dişisi, yoğun bulunduğu yer, avına uğrayan canlı ya da sürü ve yırtıcıya yem etme gibi bağlı durumlar türetilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, insanlara veya hayvanlara saldırarak onları avlayan dişli yırtıcı hayvandır.
Dişi yırtıcı, bazı kullanımlarda özellikle dişi aslan, ayrı bir biçimle belirtilir.
Yırtıcıların çok bulunduğu arazi, hayvan çekirdeğinin mekâna uygulanmış uzantısıdır.
Bir şeyi yırtıcıya yem etmek ve kurdun sürüyü parçalayıp yemesi, avlanma olayına bağlı eylemlerdir.
Yavrusu yırtıcı tarafından yenmiş dişi hayvan ile sürüsüne yırtıcı saldırmış çoban, olayın etkilediği katılımcıları belirtir.
Sınıfın kapsamı saldırıp avlama ölçütüne bağlıdır; bazı aktarımlar tilkiyi ve saldırgan sayılmayan sırtlanı bu kapsamın dışında tutar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, saldırarak avlayan yırtıcı hayvanı ortak çekirdek sayar; dişi biçimi, yırtıcıların bol olduğu arazi, sürüye saldırı, yırtıcıya yem etme ve saldırıdan etkilenen hayvan ya da çoban bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır. Sınıf sınırı salt etçillikten daha dardır.

concept_gloss.text: avlayan yırtıcı hayvan ve onun saldırısına bağlı durumlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın hayvan anlamını ve yalnız türemiş yapılarda görülen yer, avlama, yem etme ve etkilenme durumlarını birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcı hayvan çekirdeğini, saldırıyı ve saldırıya bağlı katılımcı durumlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanlara veya hayvanlara saldırıp onları avlayan canlı doğrudan adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Saldırıp avlayan hayvanın genel sınıf anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın kendisi değil, bu hayvanların çok bulunduğu arazi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yırtıcıların yoğunluğuyla tanımlanan mekân ilişkisini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin yırtıcı hayvana yiyecek olarak verilmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi yırtıcı hayvana yiyecek yapma ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yavrusu yırtıcı tarafından yenmiş dişi sığır ya da yabani hayvan

error_profile.preserves: Sınıfa giren belirgin bir yırtıcı türünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Aslan, kaplan ve benzeri öteki yırtıcıları dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Özel olarak kurt anlamındaki komşu dallarla karışabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Avla beslenme özelliğinin bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.adds: İnsanlara ya da hayvanlara saldıran yırtıcı sınıfına girmeyen etçilleri de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Beslenme türü ile saldırgan yırtıcı sınıfını birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kurt dahil çeşitli saldırgan yırtıcıları ve bunların avlanmasına bağlı durumları kapsayan üst sınıftır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle kurdu adlandırır ve kurda benzetilen hilekârlık ya da hırsızlık özelliklerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kurt, odak dalın kapsadığı saldırgan yırtıcı hayvanlardan biridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tek bir türle sınırlı değildir; komşu dal ise kurt merkezlidir ve ayrıca kurda bağlanan mecazlı insan özelliklerini içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal genel yırtıcı sınıfını ve bu sınıfa bağlı saldırı sonuçlarını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir adlandırmayla kurdu, bazı kullanımlarda da aslanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yırtıcı sınıfı ile özel tür adı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kurt ve aslan, odak dalın yırtıcı sınıfında yer alabilen hayvanlardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sınıf düzeyindedir; komşu dal ise türlerden biri için kullanılan özel bir sözlük adıdır ve bütün yırtıcıları kapsamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sınıf ile belirli yırtıcı tür adları arasındaki sınırı gösteren iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السبع والسباع من ذوات الافتراس كالأسد والذئب والنمر والفهد وما أشبهها، والأنثى سبعة أو لبؤة، والأرض المسبعة لكثرة السباع، وافتراس السبع للماشية أو ولدها، وإطعام الشيء للسباع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السبع واحد من السباع؛ أرض مسبعة إذا كثر سباعها؛ أسبعته أطعمته السبع؛ سبعت الذئاب الغنم إذا فرستها وأكلتها (maqayis)؛ السبع واحد السباع والأنثى سبعة (ayn)؛ السبع اسم يجمع السباع أسودها وذئابها؛ الذكر من السباع سبع والأنثى سبعة؛ أرض مسبعة ذات سباع (jamhara)؛ السبع واحد السباع؛ السبعة اللبؤة؛ أرض مسبعة ذات سباع؛ سبع الذئب الغنم أي فرسها؛ المسبوعة البقرة التي أكل السبع ولدها (sihah)؛ السبع يقع على ماله ناب من السباع ويعدو على الناس والدواب فيفترسها مثل الأسد والذئب والنمر والفهد؛ الثعلب ليس بسبع؛ الضبع لا يعد من السباع العادية؛ أرض مسبعة كثيرة السباع؛ سبعت الوحشية إذا أكل السبع ولدها (tahdhib)؛ والسبع معروف؛ قد وقع السبع في غنمه؛ المسبع موضع السبع (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سبع فلانا بمعنى وقع فيه أو شتمه أو طعن فيه أو عابه واغتابه، ويشمل عند بعض الشواهد عضه بالسن أو أكل لحمه مجازا كأكل السباع.

branches.branch_image_ar: المسبع: وصف ملتبس بين الإهمال والسباع والنسب
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إطلاق مسبع على الراعي الذي وقع السبع في غنمه، أو المهمل مع السباع، أو الدعي ومجهول الأب، أو المترف، أو من ولد لسبعة أشهر، أو من دفع إلى الظؤورة، بحسب اختلاف الروايات.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki kalıpta ortak bir işlev gösterir: birini çok sert biçimde ele geçirmek ya da ona kötülük ve cezalandırmada son derece ileri gitmek. Kalıbın kökeni dişi bir yırtıcıya veya sertliğiyle örnek olmuş bir kişiye bağlansa da bu açıklama ayrılığı yerleşik abartı işlevini değiştirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız çok sert ele geçirme ve en ağır kötülüğü yapma kalıplarına bağlıdır; bunlardan yalın kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplaşmış sözlerde, birini çok sert biçimde ele geçirmeyi ya da ona kötülük ve cezalandırmada son sınıra varmayı anlatan abartılı bir ifadedir. Köken açıklamaları değişse de kalıbın işlevi eylemin şiddetini en üst düzeye çıkarmaktır.

facets.statement: Kalıbın çekirdeği, ele geçirme veya zarar verme eyleminin şiddetini son derece yüksek göstermektir.
Birini çok sert biçimde ele geçirmek, kalıplaşmış anlatımın yakalama ve baskı yönüdür.
Birine kötülük etmek veya onu cezalandırmakta son sınıra varmak, kalıbın zarar yönüdür.
Kalıbın kökeni kimi açıklamalarda dişi bir yırtıcıya, kimilerinde sertliğiyle örnek olmuş bir kişiye bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kalıplaşmış sözün çok sert ele geçirme, ağır kötülük yapma ya da cezalandırmada son sınıra varma işlevinde birleşir. Kökenin dişi bir yırtıcı mı yoksa sertliğiyle ünlenmiş bir kişi mi olduğu konusunda farklı açıklamalar bulunur.

concept_gloss.text: çok sert biçimde ele geçirmek ya da en ağır kötülüğü yapmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtta verilen iki kalıplaşmış sözün aşırı şiddet ve son sınıra varma işlevini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ele geçirme ve kötülükte aşırı şiddet ile son sınıra varma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıbın birini yakalama, baskı altına alma ya da güçlü biçimde tutma yönü öne çıktığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sığır cinsi, tekil hayvan ve bu hayvanların çoğul adları etrafında kuruyor. Çobanla birlikte sürü anlamı veren bazı adlar da aynı hayvan cinsi alanında özel çoğul kullanımlar olarak kalıyor.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak ad alanını verir ve fiil ya da tamlama anlamlarını içeri taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Sığır cinsi, bu cinsin tekil bireyi ve bu bireylerden oluşan sürü ya da çoğul topluluk adlarıdır.

Bazı topluluk adları sürünün çobanıyla birlikte düşünülmesini özellikle belirtebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın şişmanlık durumunu çekirdek tutar; şişmanlatma, kilo aldırıcı ilaç, şişman bulma ve şişman bir şeyi edinme gibi türemiş kullanımları ayrı kapsamlar olarak korur.

Özel bir adlandırma, kadınlara kilo aldırmak amacıyla kullanılan ilacı gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeme eylemini merkeze alırken yiyeceği, bir kerelik yeme veya lokmayı, çok yiyeni, birlikte yiyeni ve başkasını doyuranı da aynı anlam çevresinde toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı rolleri doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış mal, ateş veya söz kullanımları bu kapsama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Besini ağız yoluyla tüketme eylemi ve bu eylemin doğrudan çevresindeki yiyecek, tek yeme, çok yiyen kişi, birlikte yiyen kişi ve başkasını doyuran kişi rolleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yiyeceği tüketme eylemidir.
Yenen şey, bir yeme keresi veya tek lokma da aynı anlam çevresinde adlandırılır.
Çok yiyen, birlikte yiyen ve başkasını doyuran kişiler eyleme katılım biçimlerine göre adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, yeme eylemini temel alır ve yiyecek, tek lokma ya da yeme, çok yiyen, yemeğe eşlik eden ve doyuran kişi adlarını bu temel etrafında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem ile ona doğrudan bağlı nesne, kerelik ve kişi rollerinin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeme çekirdeğini, yiyeceği, tek kereliği ve katılımcı rollerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin besini tüketmesi anlatıldığında doğal eylem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Besini tüketme eylemini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimseyle aynı öğünde birlikte yiyen kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte yeme ilişkisini ve kişi rolünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir öğünlük yeme veya tek lokma

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kullanıp bitirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Besin dışındaki her türlü nesnenin harcanması veya yok edilmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yemeye özgü çekirdeği genel tüketimle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yiyeceği ağızla alma ve lokma oluşturma hareketine daha dar biçimde odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yiyeceğin ağız yoluyla alınmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yeme eyleminin çevresindeki nesne ve kişi rollerini genişçe kapsarken komşu dal ağıza lokma alma hareketi ve lokma birimiyle sınırlıdır.
